title: Two Del Rio crashes: Willingham and the MJ-12 El Indio-Guerrero case
summary: UAPGerb tells of Two Del Rio crashes: Willingham and the MJ-12 El Indio-Guerrero case, about 1950-1955 at Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Del Rio, Texas / El Indio-Guerrero, Mexico

tellings.quote: >> which that's a huge can of worms because there's two crashes there. 1955 Robert Willingham in Del Rio, Texas and the 1954 Del 1950 Del Rio crash which is actually Elindio/g Guerrero, Texas, Mexico, which is only really talked about in the Eisenhower briefing document of the Majestic 12 documents.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that two different crashes of unknown craft near Del Rio, Texas often get mixed up. One, in 1955, is tied to a man named Robert Willingham. The other, in 1950, actually happened near El Indio and Guerrero on the Mexican side of the border, and UAPGerb says it shows up mainly in the Eisenhower briefing document, one of the Majestic 12 papers, a set of documents said to describe a secret group that handled UFO matters for the US government.
